data.title: A Wall Street Money Manager Speculates: Will Bitcoin Exist in 10 Years?
data.description: A Wall Street money manager says Bitcoin could vanish within a decade, but a prominent CNBC analyst calls this the most bullish moment for crypto in two years. Four concrete threats to Bitcoin's survival reveal just how close to the edge the world's largest cryptocurrency might be sitting.
